name: daily-review
_note: run_date is injected by close-eval-record.py at eval write time. Assertions marked date_specific: true use run_date to construct an exact path instead of a bare glob — preventing false passes from prior-day output files.

assertions.description: Daily review workflow state.yaml shows status: complete
Daily review output file was written to reviews/daily/ for the run date (not a prior day)
Daily review output for run date is substantive (>300 bytes)

assertions.pattern: (?i)(priorit|tomorrow|next|Q[1-4]|next week|carry into|going into|heading into|final window|rest of)
assertions.description: Daily review for run date contains priorities or forward-planning section (tomorrow, next, Q-ref, carry-forward language)
Daily review for run date contains completed items or wins section
Daily review working memory file was written for the run date
Daily review working memory for run date is substantive (>200 bytes)
Daily review working memory for run date contains expected content
